description: Podcast prep PDF rendered with wrong header, wrong table styling, and wrong overall layout. Master assumed the markdown matched the known-good format because the source structure looked similar, but the rendered PDF looked nothing like the reference. The CSS and md-to-pdf rendering pipeline produce output that cannot be verified from markdown source alone. Master confirmed 'PDF generated' and presented it without actually viewing the output.
correction: Master cannot verify PDF visual output from markdown source. Before presenting any podcast prep PDF to David, it must be visually inspected. Use the pdf-viewer MCP or render a screenshot to confirm the output matches the reference format (blue banner, orange pipe, correct table with dark blue header, teal remember bar, gray sportcoat line). Never report 'looks correct' based on markdown inspection alone.
systemic_fix: Add to podcast-prep workflow: after PDF generation, use pdf-viewer or screenshot to visually verify output against Episode 8.pdf reference before presenting to David. If visual verification is not possible, explicitly state this and ask David to review before confirming correctness.
